description:
Short title
LLM drafts of cleaning SOPs

What should the AI do?
A chatbot writes first drafts of cleaning SOPs for production equipment from our SOP template and the equipment manual. The author edits the draft, then it goes through the normal document review.

Where will it be used?
Manufacturing / production, QA / quality systems

Does the AI output directly affect a batch, a GMP record, a QC result, a release or a process setting?
No, only indirectly. Only first drafts. The author rewrites them and the SOP becomes a GMP document only after the normal review and approval.

What kind of AI is it?
Generative AI: writes or creates text, images or code (LLM). A general-purpose chatbot.

What happens with the output?
A trained person checks and approves each output before it is used

Who checks the output, and how?
The SOP author edits every draft; QA reviews and approves every SOP in the eDMS before it is issued.

Does the AI replace or reduce a check or step that people do today?
No, everything done today stays; the AI adds to it. The normal document review stays as it is.

What data goes into it?
Internal, not confidential

Who provides it?
Cloud or online service
